lore.common: Sprays snow over everyone standing by the trail, especially if they've just built a snowman.
lore.uncommon: Has skis at the front and a rubber track at the back, so it slides and grips at the same time.
lore.rare: Hopped over a snowdrift so high that it landed beyond the pine trees.
lore.epic: Raced across the frozen lake with a hundred others, and the ice fishermen held onto their hats.
lore.legendary: Crossed the whole frozen north in one week delivering soup, and the soup was still too hot to drink when it arrived.

names.legendary: Lady Velocity, Fastest on the Coast

lore.common: Revs its engine outside the café so everyone turns to look, then drives off at the speed limit.
lore.uncommon: Is so low to the ground that every speed bump makes it wince.
lore.rare: Went round the roundabout so fast that it drove into its own exhaust smoke from the lap before.
lore.epic: Raced round the track so fast that the flag waver missed it and waved at the next car.
lore.legendary: Took the twisty coast road so smoothly that the passenger's ice cream was still a perfect swirl at the other end.

lore.common: Puffs smoke over the platform just as everyone is waving goodbye.
lore.uncommon: Eats shovel after shovel of coal and still says it's hungry.
lore.rare: Whistled so loudly in the tunnel that the bats moved to a different hill.
lore.epic: Pulled a train so long up the valley that the guard at the back had to send the driver a postcard.
lore.legendary: Chuffed up the steepest mountain railway with a brass band on its roof, and the band never missed a note.

lore.common: Sloshes round every corner so loudly that you can hear its tummy rumbling.
lore.uncommon: Carries enough fuel to fill every car in the street, and won't share a drop.
lore.rare: Took the roundabout so wide that every car waited in a polite circle.
lore.epic: Drove through the night across three countries to refill every petrol station by morning.
lore.legendary: Delivered so much heating oil in one winter that every boiler in the city purred, and the cats all slept by the radiators.

names.legendary: Old Faithful Fare of Central Station

lore.common: Turns its light off just as you wave at it in the rain.
lore.uncommon: Has a little meter that ticks up faster than your heartbeat.
lore.rare: Took a shortcut through so many back streets that even the driver got lost.
lore.epic: Got every passenger across the city in rush hour faster than the train.
lore.legendary: Took a passenger to the airport so fast that they caught yesterday's flight.

names.legendary: Hooky Harry, Rescuer of the Stranded

lore.common: Arrives just after you've managed to start your car on your own.
lore.uncommon: Has a big hook on the back that it swings around like a fishing rod.
lore.rare: Winched a car out of a ditch so smoothly that the driver didn't spill their coffee.
lore.epic: Towed every stuck car off the snowy motorway in one long line, and the drivers thought they had boarded a train.
lore.legendary: Has rescued so many stranded drivers that the motorway services keep a parking space with its name on it.

lore.common: Shakes the soil so hard that the earthworms complain to the farmer.
lore.uncommon: Rakes up every weed in the field and leaves them in neat little piles.
lore.rare: Churned up a field so fine that it looked like chocolate cake.
lore.epic: Churned the whole valley so finely in one week that the moles moved out and opened a guesthouse next door.
lore.legendary: Dug a field so deep that it turned up the farmer's grandad's lost tractor, with the keys still in it.

lore.common: Spits out a bale right where the farmer wanted to park.
lore.uncommon: Ties every bale with string so tight that nobody can untie it.
lore.rare: Accidentally baled the farmer's hat, jacket and lunchbox, and he had to buy them back from the hay merchant.
lore.epic: Baled every field on the farm in one sunny day, then baled the scarecrow too. He now stands inside a very neat cube.
lore.legendary: Rolled a hay bale so big that the cows used it as a climbing frame all winter.

lore.common: Hits every stone in the field with a loud clang, then carries on as if nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Turns the soil upside down, and the worms always come up looking surprised.
lore.rare: Turned over a field so straight that the farmer used it as a ruler.
lore.epic: Ploughed every field in the county before the first frost, and the crows ate like kings.
lore.legendary: Has turned over the same farm's soil for a hundred years and found three Roman coins and a lost teapot.

lore.common: Drops seeds on the path as well as the field, so the pigeons follow it everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Plants seeds in perfect rows, so the field looks like a striped jumper.
lore.rare: Planted a whole field before lunch, and the farmer had nothing left to do all afternoon.
lore.epic: Sowed every field in the valley in one spring week, and the hills turned green together.
lore.legendary: Sowed sunflowers so evenly that the whole field turns its heads to follow the farmer on his tractor.

names.legendary: Big Blade Brenda of the Blizzard

lore.common: Clears the road and buries your driveway behind a wall of snow.
lore.uncommon: Wears chains on its tyres and jingles down the road like a sleigh.
lore.rare: Pushed through a snowdrift as tall as a house without slowing down.
lore.epic: Cleared every road in town in one night and piled the snow so high on the roundabout that children skied down it for a week.
lore.legendary: Kept the mountain pass open through the worst blizzard in a century, and the milk lorry got through.

lore.common: Drives down the lane at walking speed and every car behind has to follow.
lore.uncommon: Flings mud from its huge back wheels all over the farmyard.
lore.rare: Pulled so hard on a stuck tree stump that the whole hedge came with it, birds and all.
lore.epic: Led every tractor in the county to the harvest parade, and the jam was so slow that the corn grew another inch.
lore.legendary: Ploughed a field so big that by the time it reached the far end, the near end needed ploughing again.

lore.common: Creeps up the hill so slowly that people jog past it on the steps.
lore.uncommon: Is pulled up the slope by a long cable, with its twin coming down the other way.
lore.rare: Climbed a hill so steep that the passengers had to hold onto their hats.
lore.epic: Ran up and down the cliff all fireworks night, and its twin car got so dizzy it waved at itself in the middle.
lore.legendary: Crept up the cliff so slowly one foggy morning that the café at the top sent breakfast down to the passengers on the way.

names.legendary: Grand Junction, Pride of the Attic

lore.common: Goes round and round the loft all weekend while the grown-ups pretend it's for the children.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into a tiny tunnel and takes ages to come out the other side.
lore.rare: Came off the rails on the bend and crashed into a tiny cow.
lore.epic: Ran through the whole model village with every light on, and the tiny people waved.
lore.legendary: Ran so many laps of the loft in one weekend that the tiny station master in the model village retired to the seaside.

names.legendary: Grand Unirail of the Future City

lore.common: Glides above the street and blocks the sun from every café table below.
lore.uncommon: Runs on just one rail, as if it's balancing on a tightrope.
lore.rare: Glided between the skyscrapers so quietly that the pigeons didn't move.
lore.epic: Carried every visitor round the theme park in one day, and the queues disappeared.
lore.legendary: Has run round the same city for fifty years and still looks like it's from the future.

names.legendary: Little Puffkin, Engine of the Nursery

lore.common: Clatters round its wooden track and falls off at the same bend every time.
lore.uncommon: Joins on with magnets and comes apart whenever the dog walks past.
lore.rare: Was pushed under the sofa and came back out three weeks later covered in fluff.
lore.epic: Pulled every toy in the playroom round the track in one long line, and the teddy at the back fell asleep before the last bend.
lore.legendary: Built itself a wooden track from the playroom to the biscuit tin, and nobody has worked out who keeps adding pieces.

names.legendary: Grand Intercity, Pride of the Line

lore.common: Arrives two minutes late every day, then leaves one minute early.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its carriages so much that everyone's tea slops into the saucer.
lore.rare: Roared through the tunnel so loudly that the sheep on the hill above looked down.
lore.epic: Carried the whole city to the seaside on a bank holiday, and the beach was full by ten.
lore.legendary: Ran so precisely for a whole year that every cuckoo clock in town waited for its horn before cuckooing.

names.legendary: Old Highseat of the White Peaks

lore.common: Swings in the wind just as you're trying to sit down with your skis.
lore.uncommon: Leaves your feet dangling in the cold air all the way up.
lore.rare: Dropped a skier's glove into the snow below, and the next skier caught it.
lore.epic: Ran so fast on the busiest day that skiers reached the top before finishing their hot chocolate, and skied down holding the mugs.
lore.legendary: Carried a snowman to the top for a dare, and he skied down faster than anyone in the resort.

lore.common: Fogs up on cold days, so everyone draws smiley faces on the glass and the view disappears.
lore.uncommon: Is a little glass bubble on a cable, so you can see the whole valley under your feet.
lore.rare: Floated over the forest so high that the eagles flew underneath it.
lore.epic: Carried every hiker down before the storm so fast that some arrived at the bottom holding someone else's sandwich.
lore.legendary: Floated so high that a passenger threw a paper aeroplane out of the window, and it landed in the next country.

lore.common: Dings its bell at you while you're standing exactly on its tracks.
lore.uncommon: Gets its wheels stuck in the grooves in the road and doesn't care one bit.
lore.rare: Sparked on its overhead wire so brightly that it lit up the whole street.
lore.epic: Stopped dead in the middle of market day, and by lunchtime the stallholders had set up shop all along its sides.
lore.legendary: Rang its bell so often in one day that every bicycle bell in town learned the tune, and now they ding in harmony.

names.legendary: Old Slipway Sid of the Harbour

lore.common: Goes in the wrong direction every time the car reverses.
lore.uncommon: Holds the boat so snugly that it looks like a giant cradle.
lore.rare: Backed too far down the slipway and got its wheels wet up to the axle.
lore.epic: Backed every boat into the harbour for the summer regatta, then backed itself in too and floated about with the dinghies.
lore.legendary: Carried the same little boat to the beach so many summers that the boat now refuses to float unless the trailer is watching.

names.legendary: Grand Carrier of the Long Road

lore.common: Carries ten new cars, and every one of them gets a bird dropping before arriving.
lore.uncommon: Stacks cars on two levels like a moving car park.
lore.rare: Ducked under a low bridge with only a finger's width to spare.
lore.epic: Delivered a new car to every showroom in the country in one week, and dropped off its own driver at one by mistake.
lore.legendary: Carried ten new cars from one end of the country to the other, and every one of them still showed zero miles.

lore.common: Tips up at the worst moment and spills rubble across the drive.
lore.uncommon: Clanks behind the truck like a grumpy tin can on a string.
lore.rare: Carried away the rubble from a whole old house in one load.
lore.epic: Dumped so much rubble at the building site that it made a little mountain for the diggers to play on.
lore.legendary: Tipped up so high one day that it stuck that way, and the town uses it as a slide every summer.

lore.common: Flaps its loose straps on the motorway like it's waving at everyone.
lore.uncommon: Has no sides, so everything it carries is held on with ropes and hope.
lore.rare: Carried a whole wooden house, and the house waved at passing cars.
lore.epic: Drove with a wide load through the town, and every lamp post had to lean out of the way.
lore.legendary: Has carried boats, sheds, houses and once a whole bandstand to their new homes without losing a screw.

names.legendary: Lady Saddlebrook of the Pony Club

lore.common: Thumps and bumps all the way down the lane because the pony inside is dancing.
lore.uncommon: Has a little hay net inside so the horse can snack on the journey.
lore.rare: Refused to let the pony out until it had finished its hay.
lore.epic: Led a convoy of horse trailers to the county show, and the lanes smelled of hay for a week.
lore.legendary: Carried a pony to the beach so smoothly that it stepped out, built a sandcastle with its hooves and refused to go home.

lore.common: Drops bark on the road behind it all the way through town.
lore.uncommon: Carries a whole stack of logs that smells like a pine forest.
lore.rare: Carried logs down a mountain road so steep that the brakes squealed for an hour.
lore.epic: Carried a tree so tall down the mountain road that the squirrels at the top end got off at the next village.
lore.legendary: Carried a log so huge that the town carved it into a canoe, and the whole football team paddled it to their match.

lore.common: Rolls over the car parked next to it at the show, and pretends it didn't see.
lore.uncommon: Has tyres taller than a grown-up, so it climbs over everything.
lore.rare: Jumped over a row of old buses and landed with a bounce.
lore.epic: Crushed every old car at the stadium show, and the crowd went wild.
lore.legendary: Did a backflip clean out of the stadium and landed on all four wheels in the car park, perfectly between the lines.

names.legendary: Old Gritsworth of the Icy Lane

lore.common: Sprays salt over every parked car on the street, then drives off before anyone sees.
lore.uncommon: Spins a little wheel at the back that flings salt everywhere like someone seasoning chips.
lore.rare: Melted the ice on the steepest hill in town, and the sledgers were furious.
lore.epic: Gritted every road in the county before dawn, and the seagulls followed it inland thinking it was serving chips.
lore.legendary: Has kept the mountain road open for forty winters, and the snowploughs call it boss.

lore.common: Parks in the lay-by with its fridge humming all night, so the whole campsite thinks there's a bear.
lore.uncommon: Is a huge box on wheels that needs a lorry to pull it anywhere.
lore.rare: Reversed into the tightest loading bay in the city first time, and the forklift drivers clapped.
lore.epic: Formed a convoy of a hundred trailers on the motorway, and it took half an hour to overtake them all.
lore.legendary: Carried enough eggs to fill every supermarket in the country, and never cracked one, even over the cattle grid.

names.legendary: Lady Sweepwell of the High Street

lore.common: Brushes the gutter outside your house at six in the morning, every single Monday.
lore.uncommon: Spins its round brushes so fast that it looks like it's wearing a moustache.
lore.rare: Sucked up a whole pile of autumn leaves just as the children ran to jump in, then sneezed them all back out.
lore.epic: Cleaned every street in town after the carnival in a single night, and nobody believed it.
lore.legendary: Has swept the same high street for thirty years and found ten thousand coins, two wedding rings and a tortoise.

names.legendary: Big Bruiser, Toughest in the Toybox

lore.common: Leaves sand all over the living room carpet after every trip to the park.
lore.uncommon: Tips its little plastic back up and down until someone finally loads something in it.
lore.rare: Carried a whole family of action figures across the garden and back without losing one.
lore.epic: Moved every grain of sand from the sandpit to the flowerbed in one afternoon.
lore.legendary: Has been driven through every puddle, sandpit and flowerbed in the garden and still has all four wheels.

names.legendary: Big Rig Ruby of Route Nine

lore.common: Honks its air horn whenever a child waves from a car window, and the child's dad jumps.
lore.uncommon: Has two shiny chrome chimneys that puff smoke like it's thinking hard.
lore.rare: Took a corner so wide that it collected a hedge, a bus shelter sign and a very surprised scarecrow.
lore.epic: Drove so fast through the night that it delivered the shop's winter coats in the middle of summer.
lore.legendary: Has driven a million miles of motorway and knows every truck stop that serves the best pie.

names.legendary: Old Haulbert, Truck of Many Miles

lore.common: Crunches its gears at every set of traffic lights, so the whole street knows it's there.
lore.uncommon: Parks right outside your house to deliver a parcel to next door.
lore.rare: Carried a whole house's furniture to the new home in a single trip.
lore.epic: Got stuck under the low bridge on the busiest day, and the whole town helped by letting its tyres down one breath at a time.
lore.legendary: Delivered a whole circus big top, ringmaster and all, and set it up by mistake in the supermarket car park.

lore.common: Parks with its hazards flashing exactly where you wanted to stop.
lore.uncommon: Slides its side door open with a big clunk that wakes up the cat.
lore.rare: Fitted a sofa, a piano and a goldfish bowl into the back without spilling the goldfish.
lore.epic: Moved an entire family house in one day, and the new neighbours watched with popcorn.
lore.legendary: Fitted so much into one move that the family unpacked for a week and found a garden shed they never owned.

lore.common: Swallows your card just as you're in a hurry, then beeps at you.
lore.uncommon: Counts out notes with a little whirr that everyone in the queue listens to.
lore.rare: Ran out of money on a Saturday night, and the whole queue sighed at once.
lore.epic: Gave out only crisp new notes all morning, and the whole town spent the afternoon too nervous to fold them.
lore.legendary: Counted out a million notes in one day without a mistake, then printed a receipt so long it reached the bank manager's house.

lore.common: Creaks so loudly on the bumpy path that the baby wakes up every time.
lore.uncommon: Has a hood that folds up and down like a sleepy turtle shell.
lore.rare: Rocked a baby to sleep in the middle of a brass band concert.
lore.epic: Led a parade of prams round the park on the sunniest Sunday, and every duck came to look.
lore.legendary: Rocked a whole nursery of crying babies to sleep in one lap of the park, and the parents had their first hot cup of tea in a year.

lore.common: Tips over the moment you let go of the handle, and so do all the boxes.
lore.uncommon: Carries a stack of boxes taller than the person pushing it.
lore.rare: Wheeled a fridge up three flights of stairs with only one bump.
lore.epic: Moved every box in the warehouse in one shift, and the forklift asked for a holiday.
lore.legendary: Has moved a thousand pianos, ten thousand fridges and one very surprised grandad.

lore.common: Bumps up every stair one at a time, with a clunk on every step.
lore.uncommon: Tilts back on its two wheels like it's leaning on a wall.
lore.rare: Wheeled a whole barrel of apples through the market without dropping one.
lore.epic: Delivered every crate on the high street before the shops opened, and stacked the last one so high the baker had to climb it for flour.
lore.legendary: Wheeled a whole mountain of potatoes into the chip shop in one morning, and the town had chips for tea every day for a month.

lore.common: Has one wheel that wobbles and pulls you sideways into everyone else's luggage.
lore.uncommon: Holds so many suitcases that you can't see where you're going.
lore.rare: Rolled down the airport ramp on its own and reached the taxi rank before its owner.
lore.epic: Joined a line of a hundred trolleys being pushed across the car park, and it looked like a train.
lore.legendary: Has carried the suitcases of a million travellers and still parks itself neatly every night.

lore.common: Squeaks every time you pump the handle, so the whole warehouse knows you're working.
lore.uncommon: Slides its two flat forks under a pallet and lifts it just enough to scrape.
lore.rare: Moved a pallet of tins so heavy that the floor creaked.
lore.epic: Shuffled every pallet in the loading bay in one hour, and the lorries left early.
lore.legendary: Has moved enough pallets to build a tower to the moon, and still only goes walking speed.

lore.common: Squeaks on every turn of its wheels until someone gives it a drop of oil.
lore.uncommon: Is piled so high with blankets that nobody can see the baby inside.
lore.rare: Bumped down the kerb so gently that the baby didn't even stir.
lore.epic: Had so many toys hung from its handle that it jingled through the market like a one-pram band.
lore.legendary: Was pushed round the park so many times that it wore a path the council now calls Pram Lane.

lore.common: Refuses to fold up at the bus stop, then folds itself up the moment you try to sit the baby in it.
lore.uncommon: Has a little cup holder that nobody can fit a cup into.
lore.rare: Carried the shopping, the baby and a picnic basket all at once without tipping.
lore.epic: Raced round the shopping centre with a dozen others on the first day of the sales.
lore.legendary: Folded itself so small at the bus stop that it fitted in the baby's pocket, and nobody has managed to unfold it since.

names.legendary: Sir Stubborn, Guardian of the Kerb

lore.common: Stands just short enough that you only notice it when your shin finds it first.
lore.uncommon: Has a reflective strip that glows when headlights hit it, like it's winking.
lore.rare: Stopped a runaway shopping trolley dead and didn't even wobble.
lore.epic: Lined up with a hundred others to keep the cars out of the market square, and the square became a playground.
lore.legendary: Was knocked flat by a delivery lorry, stood back up after a week of repairs, and the lorry now takes the long way round.

lore.common: Spends all week in the garage under a cover, then gets polished for a ten-minute drive.
lore.uncommon: Has round headlights that look like big surprised eyes.
lore.rare: Started first time on the coldest morning of the year, and every modern car on the street was jealous.
lore.epic: Led a parade of vintage cars through the town, and every grandad waved a hanky.
lore.legendary: Was so loved that the family towed it on holiday behind the new car, just so it could see the sea.

names.legendary: Great Combina, Queen of the Fields

lore.common: Is so wide that it folds its front up like a sleepy bat to squeeze through the field gate.
lore.uncommon: Cuts, threshes and spits out straw all at the same time, like a giant chewing machine.
lore.rare: Worked through the night with its headlights on, so the field looked like a landing strip.
lore.epic: Harvested every wheat field in the valley before the rain came, and the farmers cheered.
lore.legendary: Harvested enough wheat for a loaf for everyone in the country, and still found the farmer's car keys in the last row.

names.legendary: Lady Breezy of the Coast Road

lore.common: Puts its roof down on the first sunny day, then gets caught in the rain ten minutes later.
lore.uncommon: Leaves everyone inside with the wildest hairdos after every drive.
lore.rare: Opened its roof in the car wash by mistake, and the driver came out cleaner than the car.
lore.epic: Led a convoy of open-top cars along the coast road, and the whole seafront waved.
lore.legendary: Has driven the coast road with its roof down for forty summers and never once got a sunburnt seat.

lore.common: Has only two doors, so everyone in the back has to climb over the front seat.
lore.uncommon: Has doors so long that it can only open them in a very empty car park.
lore.rare: Slid into the tightest parking space in the city in one go.
lore.epic: Cruised through the city at night so shinily that every shop window it passed thought it had a new display.
lore.legendary: Looked so smart at the lights that the statue in the square turned its head to watch it go.

lore.common: Wobbles off in the wrong direction every time you throw it.
lore.uncommon: Spins like a dinner plate flying through the air.
lore.rare: Flew so far across the field that it landed in the long jump sandpit.
lore.epic: Was thrown so hard at sports day that it went over the fence and into the next school.
lore.legendary: Has been thrown for so many thousands of years that it now chooses where to land, mostly near the ice cream van.

names.legendary: Old Gratius, Keeper of the Gutter

lore.common: Swallows every key, coin and earring that drops near it.
lore.uncommon: Gurgles loudly after every rainstorm as if it's laughing.
lore.rare: Got blocked with leaves and turned the whole street into a pond.
lore.epic: Swallowed so much water in a storm that the whole town stayed dry.
lore.legendary: Has drained the same street for a hundred years and still has a gold ring stuck in it.

lore.common: Sneaks up behind you on the pavement so quietly that you jump when it beeps.
lore.uncommon: Spends all night plugged into the wall like a phone.
lore.rare: Plugged itself into the neighbour's house by mistake and switched off their kettle halfway through boiling.
lore.epic: Queued with a hundred other electric cars at the charger, and they all hummed the same note until the café closed.
lore.legendary: Drove across the whole country on one charge, then plugged in at a café for a well-earned rest.

lore.common: Stops in the pit lane and has all four tyres changed in the time it takes to sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Has wings that push it down onto the road, so it could drive upside down on a ceiling.
lore.rare: Overtook three cars on the same corner and left them in a cloud of tyre smoke.
lore.epic: Raced round the circuit so fast that the crowd's heads turned back and forth like a tennis match.
lore.legendary: Drove upside down along the tunnel ceiling at the city race to prove it could, and the tunnel lights still have tyre marks.

lore.common: Lands in the tree every time you throw it, and someone has to climb up.
lore.uncommon: Curves round in the air and comes back to the wrong person.
lore.rare: Floated so long on the breeze that the dog had time to sit down and wait.
lore.epic: Was thrown round the park by every dog at once, and finally landed in the duck pond, where the ducks kept it as a raft.
lore.legendary: Flew across the whole beach on one throw, and a seagull caught it and brought it back.

lore.common: Opens its boot and drops a bag of oranges onto the car park every time.
lore.uncommon: Fits so much shopping in its little boot that nobody can work out how.
lore.rare: Squeezed into a parking space so small that the car next door couldn't open its door.
lore.epic: Did the school run, the big shop and the tip run in one morning, and a bag of compost came home in the child seat.
lore.legendary: Found a parking space right outside the beach café on a bank holiday Monday, and the whole town came to take a photo.

lore.common: Drives so slowly through town that the cyclists overtake it and then feel bad about it.
lore.uncommon: Is the longest, shiniest black car on the street, and keeps its curtains very neatly folded.
lore.rare: Glides round corners so smoothly that not a single flower in the back ever moves.
lore.epic: Led a long line of cars through the town so quietly that every shop stopped and waited politely.
lore.legendary: Drives so gently that a robin rides on its roof every morning and has never once had to flap.

names.legendary: Captain Puckett of the Frozen Rink

lore.common: Slides under the sofa every time it's dropped and is never seen again until spring cleaning.
lore.uncommon: Zips across the ice so fast that nobody can tell where it went.
lore.rare: Bounced off the goalpost, the goalie and the referee before going in.
lore.epic: Was hit so hard in the final that it flew over the glass and landed in a spectator's popcorn.
lore.legendary: Was slapped so hard in the final that it flew out of the rink, across town, and landed on the ice at next season's opening game.

lore.common: Fills up at the petrol station, drives one lap of the block, and needs filling up again.
lore.uncommon: Has flames painted down its sides and an engine sticking out of its bonnet.
lore.rare: Did a burnout in the car park and left two black stripes that are still there.
lore.epic: Roared down the drag strip so fast that its painted flames peeled off and finished the race by themselves.
lore.legendary: Was built from three old cars in a garage, and the three of them still argue about who gets to steer.

lore.common: Sprays a fine mist over everyone waiting on the beach, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Floats on a puffy skirt of air, so it glides over sand, mud and water without caring which.
lore.rare: Glided across the mudflats where every boat was stuck, and waved at them.
lore.epic: Crossed the whole channel in one roaring trip, and the seagulls had to fly fast to keep up.
lore.legendary: Has floated on air across the same stretch of sea for forty years and never once got its feet wet.

lore.common: Turns its engine off at every red light, so you think it's broken down.
lore.uncommon: Hums along on its battery in town, then suddenly purrs into engine mode on the motorway.
lore.rare: Drove to the seaside and back without needing to stop for fuel.
lore.epic: Led a convoy of hybrids across the country, and the petrol stations wondered where everyone had gone.
lore.legendary: Drove so efficiently for a year that the petrol station sent it a get-well-soon card.

names.legendary: Lady Lengthington of the Red Carpet

lore.common: Gets stuck on every tight corner because it's too long to turn.
lore.uncommon: Is so long that it takes ages for the back half to arrive after the front.
lore.rare: Fitted twelve party guests, a cake and a dog in its back seat.
lore.epic: Drove the whole school to the prom in one trip, and still had room in the back for the school bus.
lore.legendary: Was so long that it picked up the bride from her house and the groom from his at the same time.

names.legendary: Old Echoer of the Sewer Lane

lore.common: Lies open on the pavement with a little fence round it, and everyone walks the long way.
lore.uncommon: Has a workman's head pop out of it at the most surprising moments.
lore.rare: Echoed every word shouted down it, so the children queued to try it.
lore.epic: Was left open during the parade, and the brass band marched round it in a perfect circle for an hour.
lore.legendary: Let a workman climb down at breakfast who popped up at teatime on the other side of the city, holding a lost cat.

lore.common: Parks sideways in the gap between two bigger cars and looks smug about it.
lore.uncommon: Is so small and round that people think it's a toy that grew up.
lore.rare: Squeezed down an alley so narrow that the cat had to back out.
lore.epic: Was lifted by four strong friends into the hotel lobby as a joke, and the hotel kept it as a sofa.
lore.legendary: Fit forty clowns inside for the circus parade, and still had room for the umbrella.

lore.common: Rumbles so deeply at the traffic lights that the windows of the bakery shake.
lore.uncommon: Has a big scoop on its bonnet that gulps air like a thirsty horse.
lore.rare: Squealed its tyres pulling away and left everyone at the bus stop holding their ears.
lore.epic: Rumbled down main street with fifty others on parade night, and the bakery's bread rose twice as fast.
lore.legendary: Rumbled through every town on the long road west so deeply that every diner's jukebox skipped to its favourite song.

names.legendary: Old Meterman, Keeper of the Kerb

lore.common: Swallows your coin and gives you nothing, then ticks smugly.
lore.uncommon: Its little dial ticks down so slowly when you're early and so fast when you're late.
lore.rare: Ran out of time exactly as the traffic warden walked past.
lore.epic: Swallowed so many coins one Saturday that it burst open and paid for everyone's parking until Monday.
lore.legendary: Ticked so slowly for the wedding car that the whole ceremony, the cake and the first dance fitted inside one coin.

names.legendary: Old Signholder, Voice of the Crowd

lore.common: Blocks the view of everyone behind it at the football match.
lore.uncommon: Is just cardboard on a stick, but it thinks it's very important.
lore.rare: Held up a big message at the marathon finish line that made the runners smile.
lore.epic: Was waved by the whole crowd at the parade, and the street looked like a sea of cardboard.
lore.legendary: Held up a message so funny at the cup final that both teams stopped to laugh, and the referee asked for a photo.

lore.common: Spits gravel at the spectators every time it skids round a bend.
lore.uncommon: Comes back from every race with mud on its roof, somehow.
lore.rare: Jumped off the crest of a hill and flew so far that the photographers missed it.
lore.epic: Raced through the forest stage at night with its lights blazing, and every owl looked up.
lore.legendary: Raced through deserts, forests and snow, and came home with a cactus, a pine cone and a snowball still on its roof.

lore.common: Races round your ankles in the kitchen until someone trips over it.
lore.uncommon: Is steered from across the room with a little remote that's always running out of batteries.
lore.rare: Chased the cat round the garden, and the cat has been on the shed roof ever since.
lore.epic: Raced every remote car on the street round the cul-de-sac, and the neighbours put out deckchairs.
lore.legendary: Jumped a ramp in the park so high that it landed in a tree and drove back down.

names.legendary: Old Signpost, Pointer of the Way

lore.common: Points you the wrong way because someone turned it round for a joke.
lore.uncommon: Rattles in the wind so loudly that it sounds like someone knocking.
lore.rare: Pointed every tourist to the same little café, which is now very popular.
lore.epic: Got a new arrow painted on by mistake and sent the whole carnival parade through the car wash.
lore.legendary: Pointed to its village so clearly that a lost hot-air balloon read it from the sky and landed in the square.

lore.common: Has a bonnet so long that the driver reaches the junction a whole second after the car.
lore.uncommon: Is so low and sleek that it looks like it's crouching to pounce.
lore.rare: Took every bend on the country road so smoothly that the passenger's hat stayed on.
lore.epic: Raced up the hill road with a dozen other roadsters, and the sheep came to the fence to watch.
lore.legendary: Took every hairpin on the mountain pass so neatly that the goats now use its tyre marks as a footpath.

lore.common: Shows the wrong score for exactly one minute, so everyone cheers too early.
lore.uncommon: Has a few bulbs that never work, so the numbers look like they've lost a tooth.
lore.rare: Flashed GOAL so brightly that the players on the pitch had to shade their eyes.
lore.epic: Showed the score backwards in the cup final, and both teams celebrated at once until the referee checked his notebook.
lore.legendary: Kept counting so faithfully that after the stadium closed for the night, it scored the pigeons' football match too.

names.legendary: Old Swinger of the Corner Shop

lore.common: Creaks back and forth in the wind all night outside the bedroom window.
lore.uncommon: Has the menu written in chalk, which gets washed off every time it rains.
lore.rare: Was spun round by the wind so fast that it read backwards for a whole morning.
lore.epic: Swung so wildly in a storm that every shop sign on the street joined in.
lore.legendary: Swung so hard in a storm that it flew down the high street and hung itself outside the bakery, which now has two names.

lore.common: Parks with its nose against the kerb because it's shorter than most cars are wide.
lore.uncommon: Has just two seats and almost no boot, so shopping rides on the passenger.
lore.rare: Hopped into a parking space that three other cars had driven past.
lore.epic: Turned round in the narrowest street of the old town in one go, and the tour guide added it to the tour.
lore.legendary: Was lifted onto a delivery van's roof by mistake, and has toured the whole country since without using a drop of fuel.

lore.common: Wobbles off the edge of the table just as it was getting going.
lore.uncommon: Spins so fast that its colours blur into a rainbow.
lore.rare: Spun for so long that the cat watched it until it fell asleep.
lore.epic: Spun across the whole kitchen floor and knocked over every skittle on the way.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast on the kitchen table that it drilled through to the flat below, and the neighbours got a free spinning top.

names.legendary: Grandma Wagonella of the Long Trip

lore.common: Has a roof rack piled so high that it can't fit under the car park barrier.
lore.uncommon: Has a whole dog-sized space in the boot, and the dog thinks it's a palace.
lore.rare: Folded its back seats flat and became the best seat at the outdoor cinema, with nine children and a dog in pyjamas.
lore.epic: Drove the whole family to the seaside every summer, and the back seat never stopped arguing.
lore.legendary: Was packed so full for the summer holiday that granny was found in the roof box at the first service station, waving.

lore.common: Has more stickers than paint, and adds one every time it bumps someone.
lore.uncommon: Goes round the oval track so many times that it gets dizzy.
lore.rare: Pushed three cars out of the way on the last bend and still finished.
lore.epic: Did so many laps of the oval that it wore a groove, and the next race had to be run in the groove like a marble run.
lore.legendary: Has more dents than paint, survived a hundred races and still crosses the finish line every time.

lore.common: Makes you stop at the empty crossroads in the middle of nowhere.
lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a red octagon, and it's quite proud of having eight sides.
lore.rare: Got covered in snow and only the S was showing, and everyone stopped anyway.
lore.epic: Was put up in the middle of the marathon route, and ten thousand runners stopped, looked both ways and carried on.
lore.legendary: Made a million cars stop exactly in time, and one morning a runaway snail too, which waited politely before crossing.

lore.common: Flickers on and off all night right outside your bedroom window.
lore.uncommon: Is surrounded by every moth in the neighbourhood the moment it switches on.
lore.rare: Switched on so brightly that the hedgehog thought it was morning.
lore.epic: Lit up every street in town at exactly the same second, and everyone said ooh.
lore.legendary: Shone so warmly one snowy night that the hedgehogs held a party under it, and the snow melted in a perfect circle.

names.legendary: Speedy Steel, Fastest in the Pocket

lore.common: Lies on the stairs exactly where you'll step on it in your socks.
lore.uncommon: Fits in your pocket so it comes everywhere, including the washing machine.
lore.rare: Rolled down the kitchen table, along the floor and under the fridge in one push.
lore.epic: Raced round a racetrack made of books with every other toy car in the house.
lore.legendary: Rolled down the stairs, through the cat flap and down the hill, and turned up in the toy shop window at the bottom of town.

names.legendary: Grand Tourer of the Bygone Road

lore.common: Leaks a little puddle of oil wherever it parks, so everyone knows exactly where it has been.
lore.uncommon: Has wide running boards along the side that people stand on to wave.
lore.rare: Honked its rubber bulb horn so loudly that the horses in the field stampeded.
lore.epic: Drove to the seaside so slowly that the passengers got out at a village fête, had tea and still caught up.
lore.legendary: Finished the run to the sea so many times that the sea now comes out at low tide to meet it.

lore.common: Tangles its string every time you put it in your pocket.
lore.uncommon: Spins at the bottom of its string, sleeping, until you flick it back up.
lore.rare: Walked along the floor like a dog on a lead, and the real dog was jealous.
lore.epic: Did so many tricks in the playground that the whole school forgot about lunch.
lore.legendary: Was spun round the world on a single string, and came back up into its owner's hand.
